The '''PR-4''' was a model of [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] produced by [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Sienar PR-4 was added to the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] with patch 5.2 and is available from the Warbound Crusader Pack.

*[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] {{1st}}
